title: OpenLain5G
description: OpenLain5G is an open-source framework for preparing, operating, and validating reproducible 4G LTE and 5G laboratory scenarios. It integrates open-source radio access, mobile core, IMS, and UE simulation components through Docker Compose, a command-line interface, and a web interface. Software-only validation and guarded X-Series USRP workflows are provided. Hardware-dependent RF behavior must be evaluated on the specific authorized laboratory equipment and is not established by cloud-runner tests.
